text: I feel nervous before every exam.
I keep worrying about my future.
My mind never stops thinking about problems.
I panic when I have to speak in front of people.
I always expect something bad to happen.
I can't relax even when everything is fine.
I feel tense all day without knowing why.
I get anxious whenever my phone rings unexpectedly.
I keep imagining worst-case scenarios.
I feel restless before attending interviews.
I overthink every small mistake I make.
I worry too much about disappointing my family.
I feel anxious whenever I receive unexpected messages.
I can't stop thinking about tomorrow's exam.
I feel uneasy in crowded places.
I struggle to calm my thoughts at night.
I get nervous before meeting new people.
